svg.text: Top block: 40 x 25 x 39. Outer plate: 40 x 12 x 86.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Screw the outer plate to the top block and the jaw with two

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: M6 screws each, leaving a 35 mm gap between block and jaw.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Jaw: M8 tapped hole on its centre, 12.5 from the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Buffer: 5 mm rubber, 25 x 34, glued to the block's face

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: slide over the last module's frame edge, top block on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the top flange, jaw under the bottom flange; tighten the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: M8 clamp screw up against the flange.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
